channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Bid for more flats above city centre shops emerge
item.description: A bid to transform the upper floors of a city centre shopping street into flats have been lodged with City Hall.

item.title: Norfolk pubs named among cosiest in the UK
item.description: The Good Food Guide has named the 26 cosiest pubs in the UK, with the Dabbling Duck in Massingham and the White Horse in Holme included.

item.title: Councillor claims government is 'discriminating against Norfolk'
item.description: North Norfolk District Council is considering raising council tax by the maximum amount of 2.99pc this year, with officials complaining rural authorities have received the smallest increase in their funds.

item.title: Norfolk's Rotarians putting money raised to great use in a range of ways
item.description: Rotarians across the county have been busy, as usual, raising money for good causes.

item.title: Norfolk farmer banned from driving for drink driving on A47
item.description: A Norfolk farmer has been disqualified from driving for 22 months after pleading guilty to drink driving and failing to stop after a road accident.

item.title: Council organises 'informal' meeting for people most at risk from coastal erosion
item.description: People living on Hemsby's erosion-threatened coast are being invited to a meeting organised by Great Yarmouth Borough Council.

item.title: Hero of savage dog attack appeals to find baby saved from danger
item.description: A man who intervened in a savage dog attack in Great Yarmouth is hoping to reconnect with other people who were on the scene that day.

item.title: We should all feel enraged on behalf of victims of Epstein scandal
'The costs to growers could be huge': Farmer warns of risks of EU alignment
item.description: Leading Norfolk farmer Kit Papworth has sounded a warning over the UK's potential alignment with EU rules, saying “if we get this wrong, the costs to growers and industry could be huge".

item.title: Four ponies 'on the edge of life' after being found full of worms and lice
item.description: Four ponies that were "right on the edge of life" are receiving treatment at World Horse Welfare’s Hall Farm Rescue and Rehoming Centre in Snetterton
